articles.summary: 11/16/26 Semrush’s Algorithm Update Sharpens Traffic & Market Data The Traffic & Market toolkit runs on a new traffic prediction algorithm and machine learning model built for channel prediction. Semrush is raising the bar again for data quality and accuracy. As of November 9, the Traffic & Market toolkit, designed for competitive intelligence and market research, runs on a brand new traffic prediction algorithm, supported by a broader set of data sources, recalculated metrics from January 2023 onwards, and a purpose-built machine learning model engineered for channel prediction. The result? More accurate traffic estimates and deeper precision in traffic source attribution. Teams using the Trends API to access web traffic and market data will also benefit from this update, bringing the improved data directly into custom dashboards and workflows. Key Improvements: Stronger Estimates, Smarter Attribution Marketers need clarity on total traffic and the exact channels driving it, in order to accurately attribute marketing efforts towards conversions and outperform competitors. Our upgraded model sharpens both metrics, delivering a stronger foundation for competitive analysis and market benchmarking. 1. Stronger Traffic Estimates More accurate traffic estimates provide a clearer view of market trends, helping marketers identify shifts in competitor performance and market dynamics. The upgraded model now predicts domain traffic with greater accuracy: Up to 40% improvement for large domains in the US Up to 30% improvement for small and medium-sized domains worldwide With it, marketers can benchmark competitors, size market opportunities, and assess any domain's online performance with greater confidence. 2. Smarter Channel Attribution Traffic channel predictions are now more accurate, featuring: Up to 45% improvement for small and medium-sized domains in the US Up to 42% improvement for small and medium-sized domains worldwide With this, teams can pinpoint which channels drive competitors' growth and allocate their own budgets accordingly. Maximizing Brand Visibility and Impact With more accurate traffic and channel data, marketers gain a clearer picture of their brand visibility to make better-informed decisions about where to focus their efforts. From benchmarking performance against competitors and identifying emerging market opportunities to understanding which acquisition channels drive growth, these improvements help teams refine their strategies and invest resources with greater confidence. Note: Semrush Trends API has recalculated historical data with the new algorithm to align past and current data. Values may differ from what was retrieved previously. If the update affects your reporting, reach out to our team.
articles.title: Semrush’s Algorithm Update Sharpens Traffic & Market Data

articles.summary: 11/16/26 Semrush and performance.io Research Reveals How Pharma Brands Appear in Google AI Overviews Research from Semrush and performance.io shows that organic rankings remain closely linked to AI visibility, while pharma brands receive a smaller share of citations than their rankings suggest. Semrush, an Adobe company and the leading brand visibility platform, has shared early findings from joint research with specialist pharma and healthcare agency performance.io. The study found that 83.8% of Google AI Overview citations across the pharma searches analyzed came from domains ranking in the organic top 10. When an AI Overview appeared, the domain ranking No. 1 organically was cited 68.8% of the time. Citation rates declined as organic positions fell. The conclusion for pharma marketers: organic rankings remain important in AI search. But rankings alone do not show whether a brand is included in the AI-generated answer. Pharma brands face a gap between rankings and citations Across the sampled queries, pharma brand sites held 9.2% of No. 1 organic rankings but received just 4.2% of AI Overview citations—the largest proportional drop among the domain types tracked. That gap matters because AI Overviews appeared ahead of every other search results feature 98.6% of the time when present. A brand can rank first organically and still be missing from the answer above its link. As agentic search evolves, we’re observing that SEO plays a critical role in how pharma brands are being cited and chosen in AI Search. In our sample, No. 1 ranking came with an AI Overview citation almost seven times in 10. The teams that keep investing in the fundamentals, earning both rank and citations, are the ones that will move through this transition intact -Matt Lowe, CEO of performance.io For pharma marketers, the findings support continuing to invest in SEO while measuring citations alongside rankings and traffic. The practical question is whether a brand’s strong organic position also translates into being cited as a source in AI Overviews. Four years of pharma search data Previewed at Semrush Spotlight 2026, the research was led by performance.io using Semrush Position Tracking data. The study analyzed: 14,300+ keywords , covering branded and non-branded U.S. desktop searches. 689,100+ keyword snapshots across 48 months, from August 2022 to July 2026. Five therapeutic areas: Alzheimer’s disease, type 2 diabetes, non-small-cell lung cancer, plaque psoriasis and respiratory syncytial virus. Working with our agency partners allows us to see what's changing in search before it shows up in industry reports. The team at performance.io brought deep pharma expertise to Semrush data, and the result gives pharma marketers evidence to plan with. - David Power, Global Head of Partnerships at Semrush, an Adobe company The broader white paper also examines healthcare professional and patient searches, buying-signal queries and five brand case studies. About the research The findings describe associations within the sampled U.S. desktop pharma queries, not causation. AI Overview analysis covers September 2024 to July 2026, with citations matched at domain level rather than to individual URLs. The study does not measure clicks or user behavior; traffic figures in the white paper are modelled estimates. Availability Read the research summary: Rank Still Wins: How Organic Position Drives AI Overview Citations in Pharma Search.
articles.title: Semrush and performance.io Research Reveals How Pharma Brands Appear in Google AI Overviews

Launching a startup feels like running a marathon at an all-out sprint. Founders are designing the pitch deck through midnight, debugging code before sunrise, launching campaigns over lunch, and wearing twenty hats in between. They know that their product solves a real problem, but in a crowded market, building something great is only half the battle. If future customers can't find your brand, it’s almost all for nothing. That’s why we’re excited to announce the launch of Adobe for Startups. As an Adobe company, Semrush is part of this exciting program that gives ambitious founders the exact growth engine they need to turn raw ideas into breakout businesses: world-class creative tools paired directly with one of the world’s leading search and market intelligence. The best part? Eligible early-stage startups get 12 full months of Semrush, completely free. Creation Meets Discovery: The Day-Zero Growth Engine By combining Semrush with Adobe’s AI-powered creative ecosystem, founders no longer have to pick between looking credible and driving pipeline: Create and scale content with Firefly Pro Plus : Generate images, video and audio with Adobe’s commercially safe models and leading partner models, plus Photoshop on web and mobile. Turn information into action with Acrobat Studio : Edit and share business documents, extract key insights with AI Assistant and turn research into polished presentations. Build your brand everywhere with Adobe Express Premium : Quickly design social posts, marketing materials and brand assets with thousands of professional templates. Understand how customers find you with Semrush : Semrush offers startups the ability to see how their business shows up across search engines and AI-powered search and identify new opportunities to reach customers. Moreover, program participants also have the opportunity to join a community of peers through events and educational resources designed to help them learn, connect and grow. One such example includes a workshop with Artist and the Machine and its founder community on December 2, 2026. Built for Speed: How Real Founders Are Already Winning Early-stage teams are already putting these tools to work: DataCurve is using audience intelligence alongside Adobe Firefly to build dynamic visual content that evolves directly alongside fan interests. Gondola scaled its social portfolio platform from day zero by pairing sharp brand presentation with disciplined distribution. Oruk turns complex speech-AI foundation models into bite-sized visual product demos with Adobe Express to win over developers faster. Eligibility Applicants must be a startup founded within the last five years, and have raised less than $15 million in funding. Adobe will verify eligibility as part of the application process. Check your eligibility and apply for Adobe for Startups here. Next Stop: Adobe MAX Founders who are headed to Adobe MAX in Miami from Nov 10–12 should stop by the Adobe for Startups Hub to meet the teams, see live product demos, and connect with fellow founders.
